casesPageBuilder.description: The XR world is fragmented: developers, enterprise buyers and platform companies rarely share a room. XR Creator Con 2026, held in Berlin from 30 June to 3 July, was built to change that. Designed as a hybrid, it paired a global developer hackathon with a parallel business conference. Up to 4,000 developers entered the online qualification, the top 180 came to Berlin for the live finals, and around 185 enterprise guests joined alongside, over 365 people in person.
casesPageBuilder.solutionHeadline: This was not about a one-off campaign. It was about building long-term growth infrastructure.
casesPageBuilder.title: Developers, enterprise and platforms, one roof

approachDetails: Enterprise leaders came from BMW, Miele, HORNBACH, Vodafone, Nobilia, KIRA, ERGO, CUPRA (Volkswagen Group), Fielmann and MACH1 (Europa-Park), among many others. They were joined by the leading Spatial Computing platforms, Meta, ByteDance (Pico), Google, Snap and Qualcomm, creating a rare environment where builders, buyers and platforms could meet directly.

Headline sessions included a platform panel on the Future of XR & AI Glasses, with Tino Krause (Meta), Matthias Greiner (Qualcomm), Sami Belmokadem (ByteDance / Pico) and Martin Herdina; and a panel on XR & Smart Glasses in Enterprise, with Matthias Nawrocki (ERGO), Melanie Rupp (Volkswagen Group / CUPRA), Marcus Ernst (MACH1 / Europa-Park) and Simon Graff.

casesPageBuilder.description: XR Creator Con generated over €250,000 in new-business pipeline during and immediately after the event, significantly strengthened 1SP's relationships with the leading platforms, and reinforced 1SP's position as one of Europe's leading AI Wearables and Spatial Computing agencies.
casesPageBuilder.title: More than a great event

description: A hybrid event uniting a global developer community, enterprise decision-makers and the world's leading Spatial Computing platforms, all under one roof.

approachToSolution: Die Neugestaltung unseres Stores hat zu hervorragenden Ergebnissen geführt: Wir haben unsere Reichweite erweitert, den Traffic erhöht und durch Rich Media und Brand Storytelling eine stärkere Kundenbindung erreicht. Dies spiegelt sich in höheren Besucherzahlen, längeren Verweildauern und gestiegenen Umsätzen wider, insbesondere über organische Kanäle.  Die Konversionsraten sind zwar im Vergleich zum Vorjahr leicht zurückgegangen, dies entspricht jedoch der allgemeinen, auf Bekanntheit basierenden Natur des organischen Store-Traffics und dem Rückgang gezielter bezahlter Medien in den EU5-Ländern.
challenges: Es fehlten ihnen Bildungsinhalte, um neuen Kunden sowohl die Geschichte von Marshall als auch unsere Produktpalette näherzubringen.
description: Erweiterung der Reichweite, Steigerung des Traffics und Förderung einer stärkeren Kundenbindung durch Amazon Stores weltweit.
solution: Um das Potenzial der Stores voll auszuschöpfen, haben wir sie neu gestaltet, um die richtige Balance zwischen informativen, interaktiven und ansprechenden Inhalten zu finden – und gleichzeitig durchgängig starke Kauf- und Cross-Selling-Möglichkeiten zu integrieren.
subtitle: Marshall

casesPageBuilder.description:
Prime Video sought a specialised gaming agency to support the launch of Fallout, translating one of gaming’s most recognisable franchises into a premium TV series with credibility, cultural relevance, and scale.

Starting with PR and organic influencer planning in late 2023, the project expanded in early 2024 to include full event planning and execution, ensuring the series landed with impact across media, creators, and fans.
casesPageBuilder.title: Launch an Iconic Game Franchise as a Must-Watch TV Event

approachDetails: The immersive launch event brought the Fallout universe to life through scenography, performance, and storytelling, creating a shared cultural moment that resonated beyond the core gaming audience and positioned the series as a major Prime Video release.

Successfully bridged gaming and mainstream entertainment audiences, demonstrating how deep franchise knowledge, earned media, and experiential storytelling can elevate a streaming launch into a cultural event.
casesPageBuilder.description: The campaign generated widespread, high-quality coverage across top-tier German and international media, while creators from gaming and non-gaming backgrounds amplified excitement organically.
casesPageBuilder.mainHeadline: A Launch That Cut Through Culture

description: MSM.digital delivered a multi-layered launch campaign for Fallout on Prime Video, combining high-impact PR, creator engagement, and an immersive live event to turn an iconic game universe into a cultural streaming moment.
subtitle: Amazon Prime
title: Bringing the Wasteland to Life for a Global Streaming Launch

casesPageBuilder.description:
Ahead of the 2024 launch of the CUPRA Tavascan, demand was high, but supply chain delays meant vehicles wouldn’t reach showrooms in time to capitalise on early excitement. CUPRA needed a way to maintain momentum, inspire emotion, and enable dealerships to convert interest into presales without physical cars on-site.

Working with Meta Quest, MSM.digital supported the creation and rollout of a mixed reality vehicle experience designed specifically for point-of-sale environments.
casesPageBuilder.title: Generate Demand Without Physical Vehicles

approachDetails: Presales generated before physical vehicles reached showrooms
580 Meta Quest headsets deployed across Europe
5+ European markets activated (DE, UK, FR, ES, IT)
2 full vehicle models recreated in mixed reality
Multi-month rollout from pilot to pan-European scale
Plans confirmed to digitise CUPRA’s full vehicle fleet
casesPageBuilder.description: The CUPRA Tavascan MR experience successfully filled the gap between launch and delivery, equipping dealerships with an immersive sales tool that maintained customer excitement, supported sales conversations, and generated presales without physical vehicles. The success of the initiative has since driven expansion across additional markets and models.

description: To bridge a critical supply gap, MSM.digital helped CUPRA bring an all-electric vehicle to life in mixed reality, transforming dealership engagement and unlocking presales across Europe before physical cars arrived.
subtitle: Cupra x Meta
title: Driving Presales Before Cars Hit the Showroom

Our merchandisers, decorators and rack jobbers are trained specialists, not generalists. They know brand guidelines, they follow layouts precisely, and they report in real time. Across visual merchandising, shop window dressing, showcase design and regular replenishment, we maintain the standard that makes a brand look like it belongs at the front of the shelf — because it does.

name: Trainings

serviceBackground.alt: A presenter delivering digital product content.

serviceDescription:
In a competitive retail environment, the difference between a browser and a buyer is often a single, confident recommendation. FLZR training programmes are built to create that confidence — whether in a store, a webinar or an on-demand learning module accessed from anywhere in Europe.

From hands-on sales technique workshops to live product shows in our PoSLive studio, from GDPR-compliant webinars to fully branded e-learning platforms, we design training for the way retail teams actually learn. The goal is always the same: staff who know the product, believe in it, and can sell it.
